_source.title: English Wikipedia articles on each outlet (REST summary endpoint)
Live homepage check of each domain (HTTP status + <title>)

_notes: Satire/parody domains. Use as CONTEXT only (Appearance.context_flags='satire'): an earliest appearance on a satire domain means the 'claim' likely originated as a joke that was later shared as real. Never treat a satire page as corroborating evidence. Match on registrable domain incl. subdomains; also match `aliases`. Deliberately excluded: Private Eye (satirical but ALSO publishes real investigative journalism, so a blanket satire flag would mislabel real reporting); The Shovel / The Hard Times (sites resolve but no independent satire reference fetched); 'Hasi Toh Phasi' (no such satire site found - the name is a 2014 film).
